notes.title: uccessfully shortlisted！
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470441/b519c22a2a6cf57a644c9f206403d58bcd908c49.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello everyone, this is the Rainbow Legends team![/p][p]We are very excited to announce that Rainbow Legends has been selected as a finalist for the[/p][p]Game Connection × ChinaJoy 2025 Indie Game Awards, receiving a nomination for Best[/p][p]Rogue Game. This is an important recognition of our game design philosophy and overall[/p][p]quality, and we sincerely thank everyone for your attention and feedback![/p][p]At the same time, we will be exhibiting at this year’s ChinaJoy event, offering a hands-on[/p][p]demo experience on site — with booth support kindly provided by TapTap (Haoyou Kuaibao)![/p][p]Exhibition details:[/p][p]Date: August 1 ‒ August 4, 2025[/p][p]Location: Shanghai New International Expo Center, BTOC Area[/p][p]Booth: N1-G601-1 (TapTap Indie Booth)We will have the latest version of the game available for play at the booth, and we warmly[/p][p]welcome everyone to come by, try it out, and share your thoughts![/p][p]Additionally, Rainbow Legends will participate in the official finalist showcase and awards[/p][p]ceremony:[/p][p]•[/p][p]Finalist Showcase: August 1 (14:30 ‒ 16:00)[/p][p]•[/p][p]Awards Ceremony: August 2[/p][p]•[/p][p]Location: ChinaJoy Hall W4, Indie Game Zone[/p][p]The game is still in active development. We continue focusing on refining gameplay, deepening[/p][p]strategy, and improving overall systems, aiming to deliver a unique and replayable roguelike[/p][p]deckbuilder experience.[/p][p]Thanks again to all the players and partners who have supported Rainbow Legends. We look[/p][p]forward to meeting you in person at ChinaJoy![/p][p]— The Rainbow Legends Team[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470441/bc9e4b32b64faad4109fb437bcf4fded87ae1017.png"][/img][/p]
